name: vfx_diagonal_beam_pixel
trim_source_frames: 8-112 (charge orb + flash + diagonal beam + fade; frame 49 is a deliberate 1-frame black blink between charge flash and beam; faint dot trail after 112 dropped)
method: background subtraction vs median plate of empty head/tail frames (camera static, head-vs-tail mean abs diff 0.13), soft alpha = clip((max-channel diff-16)/110), NEAREST downscale to 192x108
blending: normal with transparency; Additive also works for beam glow
direction: beam travels top-left to bottom-right diagonal; charge orb at top-left
